title: The Pottery Studio Monthly Classes (Multiple Locations)
summary: The Pottery Studio offers ongoing monthly wheelthrowing and handbuilding classes at multiple U.S. locations. Classes include clay and firing for work made during the 4-session month; students are limited to 35 lbs of fired work per month.
how_to_join: Enroll in monthly class sessions through the studio's class enrollment pages.
source_quote: Our studios are open spaces in with plenty of room to create on the wheel or handbuild. We have studios that fire to Cone 10 reduction, and studios that offer Mid-Range firings. All members have 24 hour access.
evidence_sentence: The studio's homepage states it offers locations that fire to Cone 10 reduction and mid-range firings.
evidence_quote: We have studios that fire to Cone 10 reduction, and studios that offer Mid-Range firings.
